description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity class named BackupRestoreActivity. The class serves as an example and demonstration of Android's backup and restore mechanisms, including the use of BackupManager, handling persistent data files, and UI components to control backup-related data. It contains code for managing backup data, UI interactions, and initiating restore actions.

classes.name: BackupRestoreActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity class demonstrating use of backup and restore APIs, managing UI and data persistence for backup operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI controls, data file, and backup manager, and populates the UI from persistent data.

methods.name: populateUI
methods.description: Reads data from file and updates UI controls accordingly; initializes backup on first creation.

methods.name: writeDataToFileLocked
methods.description: Serializes and writes current UI state to the data file.

methods.name: recordNewUIState
methods.description: Reads current UI controls, writes data to file, and signals backup manager of data change.

methods.name: onRestoreButtonClick
methods.description: Handles restore button click, initiating restore process via BackupManager.
